name: Alpana Dangi
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026)
forbes_bio: Alpana Dangi sits on the board of financial firm Authum Investments and Infrastructure, a company in which she has a majority stake.
Authum is a non banking financial services company that is into long-term equity investments.
In 2022, Authum acquired Reliance Commercial Finance, once owned by former billionaire Anil Ambani, in an out-of-court debt resolution process.
In 2024, Authum bought a 42% stake in Prataap Snacks, an Indore-based company that is famous for Indian snacks such as fried moong dal and masala sev.
forbes_facts: Her son, Divy Dangi, and nephew, Amit Dangi, sit on the board.
The securities regulator charged her husband Sanjay with market manipulation and banned him from trading around 2010. He contested the ban and was later exonerated.

name: Olivier Bouygues
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Oliver Bouygues and his billionaire brother, Martin, control over 28% of their eponymous industrial conglomerate Bouygues Group through the holding company SCDM.
The Paris-headquartered giant, which boasts about $70 billion in sales, operates in more than 80 countries in construction, energy, telecoms and media.
Olivier has been on the board of Bouygues since 1984, while his younger brother Martin is chairman of the company.
Their father Frances (d.1993) started the construction firm in 1952. Their mother died in 2017 at age 93.
The brothers own a portfolio of wineries that includes Chateau Montrose, which they purchased in 2006.
forbes_facts: Olivier studied at the same French engineering school as fellow billionaire Carrie Perrodo's son Francois.

name: Fernando Chico Pardo
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2019-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026)
forbes_bio: Fernando Chico Pardo started his first company in Mexico City at age 27, a stock brokerage called Acciones y Asesoría Bursátil.
That brokerage later became part of Grupo Financiero Inbursa, a banking and financial group controlled by Mexican billionaire Carlos Slim.
After he left Inbursa in 2003, Chico Pardo became a controlling shareholder in Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (Asur), which operates nine airports in Mexico and one in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
He also runs private equity fund Promecap, which has acquired interests in or provided funding for a variety of Mexican companies.

name: Frank Blase
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Frank Blase runs the plastics manufacturer igus, which his father, Günter Blasé, founded in a garage in 1964.
Igus is the global leader in high-performance plastics for moving applications and has sales of more than 1 billion euros.
Blasé owns 97% of the business, his brother Carsten Blase, who lives in the USA, owns 3%.
Blase's Igus developed the world's first bike made from plastic in 2024.
forbes_facts: When his father celebrated his 90th birthday in 2021, Blasé rebuilt the founding garage of 1964 with all original parts.

name: Kuldip Singh Dhingra
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun India (2015-2022)
forbes_bio: Kuldip Singh Dhingra  is the chairman emeritus of Berger Paints India, the country's second-largest paint maker by market share.
Djhngra and his brother Gurbachan Singh Dhingra, also a billionaire, have a controlling stake in the company.
In 1991 they bought Berger Paints, then the country's smallest paint maker, from former billionaire Vijay Mallya.
Apart from India, Berger has a presence in Bangladesh, Nepal, Poland and Russia.
In August 2024, his eldest daughter Rishma Kaur was appointed chairman of the company.

name: Hans-Werner Hector
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (1996-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: One of five cofounders of SAP, Hans-Werner Hector built up the software giant's North American business.
In 1996, he transferred to a Jersey Islands trust SAP shares representing more than 10% of the company's voting rights.
When the shares were put up for sale, Hector's partners worried that their control of SAP could come under threat.
Hector wanted to diversify his portfolio for tax and money-management purposes, but the resulting rift led to him leaving SAP in 1997.
forbes_facts: In 2008, Hector established the Hector Science Fund at Karlsruhe Institute of Technology with a gift of 200 million euros ($290 million at exchange rates prevailing at the time).
His wife Josephine and he donated more than $60 million to the German city of Mannheim to renovate its museum.

name: Ipek Kirac
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025)
forbes_bio: Ipek Kirac is the adopted daughter of Inan and Suna Kirac and an heir to one of Turkey's largest conglomerates, Koc Holding.
Koc Holding operates in four main sectors: energy, autos, durable consumer goods and finance. Ipek Kirac joined its board of directors in 2016.
Other activities include technology, food, retail, tourism, agriculture and shipbuilding. Koc Group has 14 companies traded on the Borsa İstanbul.
Since 2012, Ipek Kirac has served as chairwoman and CEO of Sirena Marine Maritime Industry and Trade, a subsidiary of her father's Kiraca Holding.
Her billionaire mother, Suna, who has been suffering from ALS for 20 years, died in September 2020.
forbes_facts: Her mother's condition led Ipek to study biology at Brown University. She graduated in 2007.

name: Jerry Reinsdorf
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2026)
forbes_bio: Jerry Reinsdorf made a fortune in sports, buying Chicago teams in the 1980s and watching values skyrocket over the next three decades.
Reinsdorf led a group that bought the Chicago White Sox baseball team in 1981 for $19 million. He still owns an estimated 19% stake.
He and investors bought a controlling stake in the NBA's Chicago Bulls for $9.2 million in 1985, one year after the team drafted Michael Jordan.
Four decades and 33 years later, the Bulls are worth $5 billion; Reinsdorf owns an estimated 40%.
He made his first fortune in real estate, cofounding Balcor Company in 1973 and selling it nine years later to American Express.
forbes_facts: Reinsdorf reportedly got his start as a tax attorney for the IRS.

name: Karl-Johan Persson
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2021)
forbes_bio: Karl-Johan Persson, the third generation of his family to head up H&M, was appointed to chairman of the fast fashion favorite in 2020.
He served as CEO from 2009 when he took the reins from his father, billionaire Stefan Persson.
Karl-Johan's grandfather, Erling Persson, founded H&M in 1947.
The company has since grown into a global retail power house with more than 4,400 stores in 66 countries.
Persson's sister Charlotte S'derstr?m, brother Tom Persson, and aunt Lottie Tham, are also billionaires.
forbes_facts: Crown princess Victoria is the godmother to one of his children.
Karl-Johan is an active investor in unlisted Nordic tech companies, including online food grocer MatHem.se.

name: Bergit Douglas
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2014-2021); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Bergit Douglas owns 12.5% of Dr. August Oetker, a $9 billion (sales) conglomerate with interests in food, beverages, chemicals and hotels.
The business began in 1891 when her great-grandfather, pharmacist August Oetker, started selling non-perishable baking powder.
After World War II, her father, former Nazi SS officer Rudolf August Oetker, developed additional food products and successfully diversified.
Douglas, who has an interior design business based in Frankfurt, redesigned some of the family's hotels.
She is married to Christoph Douglas, an art consultant and former head of Sotheby's in Germany.
forbes_facts: When Rudolf August passed away in 2007, at age 90, the company's ownership was divided between his eight children from three marriages.
